import json
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

path=Path('results/training/qwen38_seed1_early_stop_ablation_plan.json')
assert not path.exists()
root=Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-seed1-training-v1')
completion=json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen38_seed1_completion.json').read_text())
assert completion['best_sft_step']==150 and completion['sft_updates']==250
record={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'register teacher-loss versus market-policy early-stopping ablation before any 27B validation policy score'},'8aa5f05d26b7205477066e1449e0af13f762a299'),
        'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'status':'registered_pending_measured_evaluation_costs',
        'hypothesis':'On a fixed training seed, lower teacher-validation loss may not select higher game expected PnL, especially after card hints. Compare the restored best SFT checkpoint with the last saved SFT update.',
        'seed':1,'model':'unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-unsloth-bnb-4bit',
        'inputs':{name:{'file':str(root/relative),'sha256':file_sha256(root/relative)} for name,relative in {
            'best_sft150':'warmstart_adapter/adapter_model.safetensors',
            'last_sft250':'sft/checkpoint-250/adapter_model.safetensors'}.items()},
        'validation':{'episodes_per_game':100,'games':['dice','cards'],'seeds':[80000,80099],'batch_size':1,'decoding':'identical greedy decoder and repair rule'},
        'comparisons':'SFT versus GRPO within each of two training seeds; seed zero versus one at each method; best versus last SFT within seed one. Five paired contrasts on each of two games.',
        'paired_interval_policy':{'descriptive_level':0.95,'family_contrasts':10,'family_level':1-0.05/10,'family_bootstrap_draws':40000,'bootstrap_seed':0},
        'admission':'Run only if measured quota permits after reserving the entire remaining primary validation/test budget. Do not submit filler if the next complete useful cohort will not fit.',
        'selection':'Validation-only diagnostic. Neither seed one nor its last checkpoint may replace the primary seed-zero candidate. No extra held-out evaluation; the existing nine-candidate family remains unchanged.',
        'training_seed_uncertainty':'Two training seeds cannot give a precise population-level training-seed CI. Paired episode intervals condition on these frozen weights.'}
path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(record['status'])
hypothesis: On a fixed training seed, lower teacher-validation loss may not select higher game expected PnL, especially after card hints. Compare the restored best SFT checkpoint with the last saved SFT update.

validation.decoding: identical greedy decoder and repair rule

comparisons: SFT versus GRPO within each of two training seeds; seed zero versus one at each method; best versus last SFT within seed one. Five paired contrasts on each of two games.
admission: Run only if measured quota permits after reserving the entire remaining primary validation/test budget. Do not submit filler if the next complete useful cohort will not fit.
selection: Validation-only diagnostic. Neither seed one nor its last checkpoint may replace the primary seed-zero candidate. No extra held-out evaluation; the existing nine-candidate family remains unchanged.
